prompt: The same sprite sheet of six objects at night: keep every object exactly where it is, at the same size, in the same pose and the same pixel-art style (a strict even grid, no anti-aliasing, consistent one-art-pixel outlines, hand-placed dithering). Each is lit warmly from one side as if by a lantern just out of frame, with deep plum and blue-grey shadows on the other side, and a thin warm-cream rim of light along its silhouette so it reads clearly on a very dark background. Palette for the dark theme: deep warm brown-black (#1A1612), dark umber (#241F19), muted taupe (#A8998A), cream highlights (#EFE6D2), and warm orange light (#E8743B). Keep the transparent background and the empty space around each object. No people, no text or letters, no logos, no frames, no grid lines, no stars, no moon, no sparkles.
